description: Solar Energy: Bans or Moratoriums (2022) is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors NREL Geospatial Data Science. This dataset identifies counties and municipalities that had a solar energy ban or moratorium as of April 2022. A TIF data file and a PNG map of the data are provided, showing areas where solar energy bans or moratoriums exist across the contiguous United States. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 5 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
